purpose: Aggregates RE-approved daily-report quantities into official contract totals and surfaces them as variance-coded exports (CSV, PDF, Excel) for NJDOT/NJTA pay estimate submissions.

loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem.description: Sums delta_quantity from v_approved_pay_item_quantities per pay item; returns a map keyed by pay item containing only items with at least one approved report.
loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem.filter_mechanism: Entirely trusts v_approved_pay_item_quantities view definition — no extra status filter applied in code.

loadPendingReviewCounts.description: Returns badge counts for dashboard; filters on status = 'submitted' rows only.

src/lib/export-utils.ts.role: Export functions for CSV, PDF, and per-inspector Excel

exportApprovedCsv.description: Produces CSV where each row quantity equals the approved sum from loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem; file suffix is _approved_summary.csv.

exportApprovedPdfReport.description: Produces PDF titled 'RE-Approved Quantity Report'; fileSuffix is approved_report.

exportApprovedInspectorDaily.description: Marks export 'RE-Approved Daily' when status = 'approved'; uses 'PENDING' prefix otherwise.

src/components/SummaryPanel.tsx.role: Desktop quantity summary table with variance % column and export button row

data_source_issue.detail: Reads live annotations, not v_approved_pay_item_quantities — does not reflect RE-approved totals; creates two-source-of-truth problem.

src/pages/ProjectControls.tsx.role: Variance tab: derives installed quantities and computes pct = installed / contract_quantity

variance_tab.issue: Submitted-but-not-yet-approved reports inflate the installed figure shown to PMs; criteria requires approved quantities for this path.

public.v_approved_pay_item_quantities.role: DB view: one row per approved daily_report × pay_item; exposes delta_quantity, approved_at, item_code, pay_item_name, unit

issue.detail: View SQL not present in supabase/migrations/; a schema change could silently break all approved-quantity paths.

acceptance_criteria.description: loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem returns only pay items with at least one approved report; draft/submitted/rejected deltas must not appear.
exportApprovedCsv row quantities equal approved sum; file labeled _approved_summary.csv.
SummaryPanel variance column: green ≤ 0%, amber 1–10%, red > 10%, dash when contract_quantity absent.
exportApprovedInspectorDaily marks 'RE-Approved Daily' when status = 'approved'; 'PENDING' prefix otherwise.
loadPendingReviewCounts returns count only for status = 'submitted' rows.

gaps.title: ProjectControls variance uses raw annotations, not approved quantities
gaps.detail: ProjectControls.tsx:180-187 sums manual_quantity ?? measurement from unfiltered annotations. A submitted-but-not-yet-approved report inflates the installed figure shown to PMs.
gaps.fix: Replace raw annotation sum with loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem; or clearly label the figure as 'Submitted (Pending Approval)' to avoid misleading comparisons.

gaps.title: SummaryPanel uses live annotations instead of v_approved_pay_item_quantities
gaps.detail: The embedded summary in the main takeoff tool does not reflect RE-approved totals, creating a two-source-of-truth problem with exportApprovedCsv/PDF.
gaps.fix: Feed SummaryPanel from loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem for the approved totals column, or add a second column distinguishing live vs approved.

gaps.title: No payment-period date-range scoping for exports
gaps.detail: No UI or helper exists to export quantities scoped to a specific payment period. A pay estimate must be computed by manually diffing two full exports.
gaps.fix: Add optional dateFrom/dateTo parameters to loadApprovedTotalsByPayItem and the CSV/PDF export helpers; expose a date-range picker in the export UI.

gaps.title: v_approved_pay_item_quantities SQL not in migrations
gaps.detail: The view is consumed everywhere but its DDL is absent from supabase/migrations/; a schema change could silently break all approved-quantity paths.
gaps.fix: Add a CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW migration for v_approved_pay_item_quantities.

cross_stream_handoffs.feeds_from: daily-report-lifecycle — v_approved_pay_item_quantities populated only when daily_reports.status = 'approved'
feeds_into: P6/schedule export stream — exportApprovedCsv and exportApprovedPdfReport are the deliverable artifacts; P6Export.tsx is a sibling consumer of pay-item data
Dashboard/Summary — SummaryPanel embedded in Index.tsx reads live annotations (known inconsistency)

summary: Core approved-quantity rollup, export utilities, and variance color coding all satisfy acceptance criteria. Two notable gaps remain: (1) ProjectControls variance tab inflates installed totals with unapproved data, and (2) no payment-period date-range scoping exists for exports, requiring manual diffing for NJDOT/NJTA pay estimates.
